context: {SOURCE} involving {SUBJECT} ({ROLE}, {ORG}). Judge ONLY {S}'s own behaviour shown in this item; ignore what anyone else did. Lines authored by {S} are prefixed '{S}:'.

substantive.instructions: Does this item show {S} doing substantive work (building, shipping, deciding, reviewing, debugging, operating, teaching, coordinating delivery), rather than only social chat, scheduling, acknowledgements, or automated output?

criteria.false: chatter, logistics, or no real contribution by {S}

outcome.instructions: Does the item show a concrete, observable outcome of {S}'s work (shipped change, production result, metric moved, incident resolved, decision recorded), not just intent or discussion?

ai.instructions: Does {S} use AI (agents, LLMs, AI-built tooling) to move faster, go further, or raise quality in this item?

reach.instructions: How far does the effect of {S}'s contribution in this item reach?

criteria.cross_team: other teams or a wider org area
criteria.company: company-wide, or merchants and buyers at scale

concern.instructions: Does this item show {S} falling short? Pick the most prominent shortfall in {S}'s own behaviour, or none.
